text: The same grille with the filled grid copied out column by column instead of row by row.
Every card, any key of 1-4 letters and each of 200,563 words, after or before; the search guesses how many empty squares precede each known letter and checks the guess as they appear.

No card fits K4 or any of ten copies in either arm. The free-key plants are found; the two English key-word plants were cut by the clock after every copy had finished, and the self-check found 16 of 16 planted words. Free keys of 5-26 letters blocked by cost.
